annotations.title: WhatsApp number settings, blocklist and groups

description: Everything about ONE WhatsApp business number except sending. PROFILE: "get" reads, "update" changes only what you pass: about ≤139, address ≤256, description ≤512, email ≤128, websites (≤2), vertical, photoUrl (JPEG/PNG), iceBreakers (≤4 tappable questions, ≤80, no emoji), commands ([{ name, hint }], ≤30, typed after /), welcomeMessage. BLOCKLIST: "list_blocked", "block", "unblock" with users (phones or business-scoped ids, ≤1,000; only people who wrote in the last 24 hours can be blocked). GROUPS (Official Business Accounts only; ≤8 people, joining only by invite link): "list_groups", "get_group", "create_group" (subject ≤128, description ≤2048, joinApproval), "invite_link", "update_group", "reset_invite_link", "remove_participants", "delete_group" (also confirmName = the subject), "join_requests" / "approve_join_requests" / "reject_join_requests" (joinRequestIds), "add_participants" (WhatsApp has NO add: it answers the invite link to send). NUMBER: "registration" (status, verification, platform), "register" (pin = its 6-digit two-step PIN, used once and never stored; dataRegion), "request_code" (method SMS | VOICE) and "verify_code" (code) to re-verify, "display_name" and "request_display_name" (displayName; Meta reviews it, then register again within 14 days), "username" / "username_suggestions" / "set_username" (username, transfer) / "delete_username", "commerce_settings" / "update_commerce_settings" (cartEnabled, catalogVisible). Every change customers or members see takes confirm:true after a first call without it, which changes nothing. Over a limit is refused, never cut. Answers are read back from Meta. Send to a group with send_whatsapp_message groupId. 0 credits.

dataRegion.description: register: where messages are stored at rest, e.g. DE, IN

description.description: update: the profile description; create_group/update_group: the group description

transfer.description: set_username: take it from another number in the business

users.description: block / unblock: phones in international form or business-scoped user ids

vertical.description: e.g. RETAIL, RESTAURANT, BEAUTY, EDU, HEALTH, PROF_SERVICES, OTHER
